calls_follow_due_idx.name: calls_follow_due_idx
calls_follow_due_idx.where: "calls"."follow_checked_at" is null and "calls"."closed_at" is not null

calls_ended_now_by.name: calls_ended_now_by
calls_ended_now_by.value: "calls"."ended_now_by" is null or ("calls"."ended_now_by" in ('host', 'customer', 'customer_untold') and "calls"."safety_ended_at" is not null and "calls"."safety_ended_by" is not null)

calls_end_report.name: calls_end_report
calls_end_report.value:
("calls"."end_report_effect" is null and "calls"."end_report_at" is null)
        or ("calls"."end_report_effect" is not null and "calls"."end_report_effect" in ('minutes', 'minutes_uncounted', 'whole') and "calls"."end_report_at" is not null and "calls"."ended_now_by" is not null and "calls"."ended_now_by" = 'customer')

generated.as: case when started_by is null then 'helper' when started_by = host_id then 'host' else 'founder' end

contribution_payments_taken_shape.name: contribution_payments_taken_shape
contribution_payments_taken_shape.value: ("contribution_payments"."status" = 'taken') = ("contribution_payments"."taken_at" is not null) and ("contribution_payments"."taken_at" is null) = ("contribution_payments"."taken_cents" is null)

contributions_tip_shape.name: contributions_tip_shape
contributions_tip_shape.value: ("contributions"."kind" = 'tip') = ("contributions"."call_id" is not null) and ("contributions"."kind" = 'tip') = ("contributions"."tip_cents" is not null) and ("contributions"."kind" = 'tip') = ("contributions"."project_id" is null)

host_photo_tries_entry.name: host_photo_tries_entry
host_photo_tries_entry.value: ("host_photo_tries"."network" = 'upload' and "host_photo_tries"."entry_name_key" is null and "host_photo_tries"."entry_account_id" is null) or ("host_photo_tries"."network" <> 'upload' and "host_photo_tries"."entry_name_key" is not null)

host_photos_source.name: host_photos_source
host_photos_source.value: ("host_photos"."network" = 'upload' and "host_photos"."source_name_key" is null and "host_photos"."source_account_id" is null) or ("host_photos"."network" <> 'upload' and "host_photos"."source_name_key" is not null and "host_photos"."source_account_id" is not null)

membership_months_not_negative.name: membership_months_not_negative
membership_months_not_negative.value: "membership_months"."free_cents" >= 0 and "membership_months"."set_aside_cents" >= 0 and "membership_months"."used_cents" >= 0 and "membership_months"."expired_cents" >= 0 and "membership_months"."to_pay_back_cents" >= 0 and "membership_months"."paid_back_cents" >= 0 and "membership_months"."host_caused_cents" >= 0 and "membership_months"."total_cents" > 0

memberships_fourteen_request.name: memberships_fourteen_request
memberships_fourteen_request.value: ("memberships"."fourteen_asked_at" is null) = ("memberships"."fourteen_month_id" is null) and ("memberships"."fourteen_admin_id" is null) = ("memberships"."fourteen_request_day" is null) and ("memberships"."fourteen_admin_id" is null or "memberships"."fourteen_asked_at" is not null)

payments_kind_shape.name: payments_kind_shape
payments_kind_shape.value:
("payments"."kind" = 'card' and "payments"."call_id" is not null and "payments"."month_id" is null and "payments"."contribution_payment_id" is null)
        or ("payments"."kind" = 'member_call' and "payments"."call_id" is not null and "payments"."month_id" is not null and "payments"."contribution_payment_id" is null)
        or ("payments"."kind" = 'member_expired' and "payments"."call_id" is null and "payments"."month_id" is not null and "payments"."contribution_payment_id" is null)
        or ("payments"."kind" = 'contribution' and "payments"."call_id" is null and "payments"."month_id" is null and "payments"."extension_id" is null and "payments"."contribution_payment_id" is not null
          and "payments"."stripe_payment_intent_id" is null and "payments"."price_per_15_cents" = 0 and "payments"."covers_from" = "payments"."covers_until"
          and "payments"."status" = 'charged' and "payments"."charged_cents" is not null and "payments"."charged_cents" = "payments"."booked_cents" and "payments"."charged_at" is not null
          and "payments"."covers_from" = "payments"."charged_at" and "payments"."original_fee_cents" is not null and "payments"."original_host_share_cents" is not null
          and "payments"."original_fee_cents" + "payments"."original_host_share_cents" = "payments"."charged_cents" and "payments"."stripe_charge_id" is not null)

social_accounts_provider_uq.name: social_accounts_provider_uq
social_accounts_provider_uq.where: "social_accounts"."confirmed_at" is not null and "social_accounts"."provider_account_id" is not null
